gene that causes CF. To have CF, an individual must inherit two 
defective genes, one from each parent. Each time two carriers 
conceive, there is a 25% chance that their child will have CF; a 
50% chance that the child will be a carrier of the CF gene; and 
a 25% chance that the child will be a noncarrier. Most individu-
als with CF are diagnosed by age 3; however, nearly 10% of new 
cases are diagnosed at age 18 or older. Th e median survival age 
for individuals with CF is now projected to be 37.4 years.133
